compiled_state.title: As a sprint orchestrator, the session worktree's pre-commit hook accepts merge commits and rejects non-merge commits in sprint-active state
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Pre-commit hook on the session worktree scoped to sprint-active state via .sprint-active marker file (created Phase A, removed Phase I). Hook accepts merge commits, rejects all non-merge commits with a documented error pointing the user to a story worktree. Escape hatch: setting DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0 env var bypasses the hook for emergency commits with an audit log entry.
**Why**: Eliminates the silent-leakage failure mode where sub-agents wrote directly to the session worktree. Combined with S7 (leakage detector), provides defense in depth.

**Scope**:
- IN: Pre-commit hook file installation in session worktree
- IN: .sprint-active marker file lifecycle: Phase A creates it; Phase I removes it; Phase A is idempotent on re-run; orphaned-marker cleanup on session abandonment
- IN: DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0 env override bypasses with audit log entry to artifacts dir
- IN: Outside sprint-active state, hook is inactive (release pipeline merge-to-main.sh runs in non-sprint mode)
- OUT: Leakage detection / cherry-pick handling — owned by S7

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, a direct-edit non-merge commit attempted in the session worktree with .sprint-active marker present is rejected with the documented error
  ← Satisfies: "SC3: Session-worktree merge-only policy"
- When this story is complete, a merge commit attempted in the session worktree with .sprint-active marker present is accepted
  ← Satisfies: "SC3"
- When this story is complete, DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0 bypass succeeds and writes an audit log entry to the artifacts dir
  ← Satisfies: "SC3 escape hatch"
- When this story is complete, a direct-edit commit attempted in the session worktree without .sprint-active marker present (e.g., release pipeline) is accepted
  ← Satisfies: "SC3 sprint-active scoping"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] .sprint-active marker file lifecycle: define which phase creates it (Phase A) and removes it (Phase I), behavior on session abandonment (orphaned marker cleanup), behavior across worktree boundaries (gitignored, never committed), and interaction with DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0 escape hatch (does the env var require marker removal or override its presence?). Document the chosen behavior.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
